sourceLabel: Sina Finance market centre node tree
notes: Industries are the Sina 申万行业 (sw_*) board family (all 31 kept even when empty); concepts are gn_* boards (chgn_* only with --include-hot-concepts). count is the deduplicated member count; membership maps each 6-digit code to its board ids. A board with count 0 is still listed in Sina's node tree but reports no members (retired id). 1 request(s) failed and those boards may be short of members: gn_hnzm#1
